Players Committee errata-sheet slip of [[Grand Admiral Thrawn (V) (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2), game text: “[Pilot] 3. If a Rebel just moved from here, your Imperials present may follow that character (using landspeed). While at a battleground site, functions as a general and game text of Admiral's Orders is canceled.”

Source: [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Errata-082022.pdf Errata Sheet August 2022] (Players Committee), page 1, printed edition August 2022. The PDF build metadata is 6 August; it does not establish a publication day. The slip is the image embedded in the PDF; its transparent areas (where the card underneath shows through) are shown white.

Edits: none.
